display.title: The Mitzvah House: Fixing Your Tzedakah Pushka to the Wall
display.summary_short: How to turn your whole house into a big mitzvah: attach your tzedakah pushka permanently to a wall, and your home becomes part of the mitzvah that brings Moshiach sooner.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that the word mitzvah means not only a commandment but also a connection: each mitzvah joins us to Hashem. A house can be connected to a mitzvah too. If you fix your tzedakah pushka permanently to a wall of your home, with a nail, tape or glue, the whole house becomes part of the mitzvah of tzedakah, which our Sages say is so great that it brings the Geulah closer. The 'order of the day' for members of Tzivos Hashem is to tell their parents the good news and ask them to help attach the pushka. A home connected to tzedakah invites Hashem to dwell there, protecting and blessing the family in body and soul. The talk ends by encouraging children to put a few coins in their pushka.
display.lesson: Make tzedakah a permanent part of your home, and your whole house becomes a mitzvah that brings Moshiach sooner.
